title: Calvert with Cockcroft-Gault from the patient's creatinine
description: 70-year-old man, 80 kg, creatinine 1.4 mg/dL: CG = (140-70) x 80 / (72 x 1.4) = 55.6 mL/min; dose = 5 x (55.6 + 25) = 403 mg. Phase 0 returns the constant 625 mg.
